sources.overlap: Overlaps smaller ads and tracking lists. Review false positives before combining sources.

sources.name: Phishing Army
sources.access_note: The aggregation adds no access restriction. Independent source terms still apply to use and redistribution.

sources.name: URLhaus (online mirror)
sources.access_note: This third-party mirror needs no Auth-Key. Direct URLhaus downloads require an Auth-Key. Commercial use may require a paid subscription. Never store credentials in this package.
sources.scope_note: The mirror derives hostnames from URLs marked online by URLhaus. The former official hostfile also included recent entries. The maintainer applies separate popularity exclusions.
sources.update_note: The legacy hostfile URL no longer serves the list. Verify the mirror update date before subscribing.

sources.license_note: The website and Android app licenses do not establish the current hosts-file license.

sources.overlap: Substantial overlap with other general-purpose lists.

sources.name: HaGezi Light
sources.update_note: The current repository separates legacy Hosts and Subdomains formats. Verify the current native preset and update health.

selection_notes: Start with a small ads/tracking list and a malware list.
Review false positives before adding broader coverage.
Avoid stacking a larger general-purpose list on both Peter Lowe and AdAway.
No source is fetched by the package.
Check licenses and current access terms before redistributing list contents.
